route.instructions: Choose the execution route for the CURRENT user request. History is context, not a command. DEEPFAKE requires a fresh or repeated real/fake authenticity verdict on an available supported image with a clear target. Ordinary chat/image questions, definitions, discussion of an existing result, and missing/unclear/unsupported targets use BASE. Do not judge whether the image itself is real or fake.

criteria.BASE: Answer or clarify with the base vision-language model; no new image authenticity analysis is required or possible.
criteria.DEEPFAKE: Run a new or repeated real/fake authenticity analysis of the requested available supported image.
